# Wait for QR image and section mutations at the UI boundary

The wizard tests verify image data, localized progress arguments and bounded next/back methods in an isolated content tab fixture. Pane tests observe the img src mutation when stepping and the hidden attribute when entering Codes. They also inspect Next/Done labels and summary contents. Register a condition tied to the visible transition rather than assuming a synthesized click finishes asynchronous generation. These assertions were read only; they do not replace scanability, focus or screen-reader tests.

Scope: mail/components/preferences.
